summary: DHARA v2.2 consent management UI and backend tested. All key UI elements (toggles, record card, history accordion) render correctly. Critical bug found: /api/user/me endpoint missing — consent record shows '—' values and toggles default to false. All backend APIs (consent-history, privacy-choices) pass. EL-054 and EL-055 verified via code review.

critical.issue: Endpoint does not exist (returns 404). data-privacy.tsx fetches from ${API_BASE}/api/user/me to load consent_purposes and terms_version/accepted_at for consent record card and toggles. The actual endpoint is /api/auth/me. This causes consent preferences toggles to default to false and consent record card to always show '—' for Notice Version and Last Updated.

minor.issue: EL-055 test asks for GET /api/evidence/vault returning 403 when EVIDENCE_LOCKER_ENABLED=false. This endpoint does not exist. The flag guard exists in _flags_or_503() (evidence_vault_router.py line 47-52) which returns HTTP 503 (not 403) when evidence_locker_enabled=false. No /evidence/vault GET route is defined — existing routes are /evidence/anchor, /evidence/upload/*, /evidence/backups.

ui_bugs.issue: Consent record card always shows '—' for Notice Version and Last Updated because /api/user/me returns 404. Fix: change fetch URL from /api/user/me to /api/auth/me in data-privacy.tsx line 107
Analytics and Updates toggles always show OFF (false) because /api/user/me returns 404 — consent_purposes never loaded. Same root cause as above.

action_items: CRITICAL: Fix data-privacy.tsx line 107: change fetch URL from `${API_BASE}/api/user/me` to `${API_BASE}/api/auth/me` to load consent_purposes, terms_version, terms_accepted_at correctly

EL-055 clarification: GET /api/evidence/vault does not exist. The flag guard (_flags_or_503) correctly blocks existing evidence endpoints (POST /evidence/anchor etc.) with 503 when evidence_locker_enabled=false. If a dedicated GET /evidence/vault list endpoint is needed, it needs to be added to evidence_vault_router.py
EL-054: sweepOrphanedEvidenceTempFiles confirmed defined in evidenceStore.ts and called on mount in evidence-locker.tsx line 279 — PASS
critical_code_review_comments: data-privacy.tsx line 107: fetches /api/user/me which returns 404. Should be /api/auth/me (confirmed the actual endpoint in auth_router.py line 570)

EL-055: evidence_vault_router.py has no GET /evidence/vault endpoint. _flags_or_503() returns 503 (not 403) for disabled state. All evidence endpoints require both evidence_locker_enabled AND evidence_vault_enabled flags.

success_rate.backend: 92% (12/13 tests passed - 1 failure on test_persists_to_user_me due to /api/user/me 404)
success_rate.frontend: 60% (UI elements render correctly but consent record data not loading due to wrong API endpoint)

context_for_next_testing_agent: After main agent fixes /api/user/me → /api/auth/me in data-privacy.tsx, retest: (1) consent record shows real version/timestamp, (2) analytics and updates toggles reflect actual saved preferences. Backend test file: /app/backend/tests/test_consent_v2_2.py
rca_of_issue: Root cause: data-privacy.tsx line 107 calls `fetch(${API_BASE}/api/user/me, ...)` but GET /api/user/me is not a registered route in server.py or any router. The user profile endpoint is registered in auth_router.py as `@router.get('/auth/me')` which mounts as `/api/auth/me`. Fix: change line 107 from `${API_BASE}/api/user/me` to `${API_BASE}/api/auth/me`. Reproduction: load /settings/data-privacy when logged in — consent record shows '—' and both toggles are OFF.
